cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 90% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.31% · WTI +0.44% · Brent +1.25% · NatGas -1.55%. 90% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +4.20%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +4.20%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.10%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +11.98%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +11.98%, BE +11.13%, ARRY +6.77%, VRT +5.55%, VLO +5.50%. Laggards: FSLR -1.78%, BWXT -1.30%, PEG -0.52%, NEE -0.24%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
